# PastForward — full catalogue and answers

> Real 12-inch upcycled records with the album printed on the centre label, made to hang. Posters, prints and polaroids too. Delivered across India.

- **Website**: https://pastforward.shop
- **Delivers to**: India only
- **Delivery time**: 7–10 days from order
- **Delivery cost**: Delivery is free, anywhere in India.
- **Payment**: UPI, cards and net banking. Cash on delivery isn't available yet.
- **Returns**: made to order, so no change-of-mind returns. If an order arrives damaged or wrong, email within 7 days of delivery for a replacement or refund.
- **Contact**: contact@pastforward.shop · Instagram @pastforward.shop

## Formats and prices
- **Vinyl** (12-inch record, ⌀305mm): ₹999
- **A3 poster** (297 × 420mm): ₹299
- **A5 poster** (148 × 210mm): ₹199
- **10×10 print** (254 × 254mm): ₹249
- **Polaroid card**: ₹99

## Questions
### Is it a real vinyl record?
Yes. A real 12-inch upcycled record. Every record we sell already had a life before it got to you; we clean it up and set the artwork into the centre label. Nothing is pressed new for decor.

### Can I play it?
It's sold to hang, not to play. These are real records, so the grooves are real — but we make no promise about what's on them or how it sounds, and the label carries our artwork rather than the original. Treat it as a wall piece.

### Why upcycled and not new?
Because a record that already had a life is the whole point of the name. It also means no two are identical, and nothing new gets pressed just to hang on a wall.

### What sizes do you make?
Vinyl · 12-inch record, ⌀305mm. A3 poster · 297 × 420mm. A5 poster · 148 × 210mm. 10×10 print · 254 × 254mm. Polaroid card.

### How does a record hang?
Every record comes with a wall hook in the box. Put the hook up and hang the record on it.

### How long does delivery take?
7–10 days from when you order, anywhere in India.

### What does delivery cost?
Delivery is free, anywhere in India.

### How can I pay?
By UPI, cards and net banking, on a secure checkout. Cash on delivery isn't available yet.

### Do you ship outside India?
Not yet. We deliver anywhere in India for now.

### What if it arrives damaged?
Email contact@pastforward.shop within 7 days of delivery with a photo, and we'll put it right. See returns.

### Can you make one that isn't on the site?
Yes. That's what custom orders are for — tell us the artist and album and we'll make it.

### How do I look after it?
Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep it out of direct sunlight — same as the original.
